top_retrieved_context.snippet: Tobe Awaka F Oct 30 Day-To-Day Oct 29: Awaka (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.
Dennis Schroder G Oct 30 Day-To-Day Oct 29: Schroder (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against the Wizards.
Jalen Smith F Oct 30 Day-To-Day Oct 29: Smith is questionable for Friday's game against Boston with a left finger sprain.
Meleek Thomas G Oct 31 Day-To-Day Oct 29: Thomas (foot) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Hawks, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

Trail Blazers' Ja Morant exits first game vs. Grizzlies with hamstring injury. Ja Morant exited his first game against his former team in the fourth quarter Thursday night because of a left hamstring injury.
Devin Carter G Nov 8 Out Oct 18: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.
Patrick Williams F Oct 30 Out Oct 29: Williams (adductor) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.
Knicks' Jose Alvarado (ankle) to miss fourth straight vs. 76ers. Knicks reserve guard Jose Alvarado will miss Friday's NBA Cup game against the 76ers because of a right ankle injury.
